notes.zh: 审阅注：佣兵城邦空间站卷入战斗时（on_entering_battle，00_on_actions.txt:1378，enclave.27），城邦召回已出租舰队；若租用方不是攻击者，1天后向其发出本通知并退款（overlord_enclaves_events.txt:352-397）。灵督城邦使用另一套文本。
notes.en: Review note: when a mercenary enclave station enters battle (on_entering_battle, 00_on_actions.txt:1378, enclave.27) the enclave recalls its leased fleet; if the client is not the attacker it gets this notice with a refund one day later (overlord_enclaves_events.txt:352-397). Mindwarden enclaves use their own wording.
